title: DZY Loves Bridges
statementMd:
DZY owns $2^{*m*}$ islands near his home, numbered from $1$ to $2^{*m*}$. He loves building bridges to connect the islands. Every bridge he builds takes one day's time to walk across.

DZY has a strange rule of building the bridges. For every pair of islands $*u*, *v* (*u* ≠ *v*)$, he has built $2^{*k*}$ different bridges connecting them, where ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f49993c7f44afef1236372301838fdcaf31e0226.png) ($*a*|*b*$ means $*b*$ is divisible by $*a*$). These bridges are bidirectional.

Also, DZY has built some bridges connecting his home with the islands. Specifically, there are $*a*_{*i*}$ different bridges from his home to the $*i*$-th island. These are one-way bridges, so after he leaves his home he will never come back.

DZY decides to go to the islands for sightseeing. At first he is at home. He chooses and walks across one of the bridges connecting with his home, and arrives at some island. After that, he will spend $*t*$ day(s) on the islands. Each day, he can choose to stay and rest, or to walk to another island across the bridge. It is allowed to stay at an island for more than one day. It's also allowed to cross one bridge more than once.

Suppose that right after the $*t*$-th day DZY stands at the $*i*$-th island. Let $*ans*[*i*]$ be the number of ways for DZY to reach the $*i*$-th island after $*t*$-th day. Your task is to calculate $*ans*[*i*]$ for each $*i*$ modulo $1051131$.

## Input

To avoid huge input, we use the following way to generate the array $*a*$. You are given the first $*s*$ elements of array: $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*s*}$. All the other elements should be calculated by formula: $*a*_{*i*} = (101·*a*_{*i* - *s*} + 10007) *mod* 1051131$ $(*s* < *i* ≤ 2^{*m*})$.

The first line contains three integers $*m*, *t*, *s*$ $(1 ≤ *m* ≤ 25; 1 ≤ *t* ≤ 10^{18}; 1 ≤ *s* ≤ *min*(2^{*m*}, 10^{5}))$.

The second line contains $*s*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*s*} (1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6})$.

## Output

To avoid huge output, you only need to output xor-sum of all the answers for all $*i*$ modulo $1051131$ $(1 ≤ *i* ≤ 2^{*m*})$, i.e. $(*ans*[1] *mod* 1051131) *xor* (*ans*[2] *mod* 1051131) *xor*... *xor* (*ans*[*n*] *mod* 1051131)$.

## Note

In the first sample, $*ans* = [6, 7, 6, 6]$.

If he wants to be at island 1 after one day, he has 6 different ways:

1. home —> 1 -(stay)-> 1
2. home —> 2 —> 1
3. home —> 3 —> 1
4. home —> 3 —> 1 (note that there are two different bridges between 1 and 3)
5. home —> 4 —> 1
6. home —> 4 —> 1 (note that there are two different bridges from home to 4)

In the second sample, $(*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3}, *a*_{4}, *a*_{5}, *a*_{6}, *a*_{7}, *a*_{8}) = (389094, 705719, 547193, 653800, 947499, 17024, 416654, 861849)$, $*ans* = [235771, 712729, 433182, 745954, 139255, 935785, 620229, 644335]$.
statementZhMd:
DZY 的家附近有 $2^{*m*}$ 个岛屿，编号从 $1$ 到 $2^{*m*}$。他喜欢建造连接岛屿的桥梁。他建造的每座桥走过去都需要一天时间。

DZY 建造桥梁时有一条奇怪的规则。对于任意一对岛屿 $*u*, *v* (*u* ≠ *v*)$，他在它们之间建造了 $2^{*k*}$ 座不同的桥梁，其中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f49993c7f44afef1236372301838fdcaf31e0226.png)（$*a*|*b*$ 表示 $*b*$ 能被 $*a*$ 整除）。这些桥都是双向的。

此外，DZY 还建造了一些连接他的家与各个岛屿的桥。具体来说，从他的家到第 $*i*$ 个岛屿有 $*a*_{*i*}$ 座不同的桥。这些桥是单向的，因此他离开家后将永远不会回去。

DZY 决定去这些岛屿观光。起初他在家中。他选择并走过一座连接家与岛屿的桥，到达某个岛屿。之后，他将在岛屿上度过 $*t*$ 天。每天，他可以选择停留休息，或者走过桥前往另一个岛屿。在一个岛屿停留超过一天是允许的。同一座桥走过多次也是允许的。

假设在第 $*t*$ 天结束后，DZY 正站在第 $*i*$ 个岛屿。令 $*ans*[*i*]$ 表示 DZY 在第 $*t*$ 天结束后到达第 $*i*$ 个岛屿的方案数。你的任务是计算每个 $*i*$ 的 $*ans*[*i*]$，结果对 $1051131$ 取模。

## 输入格式

为了避免输入数据过大，我们使用以下方式生成数组 $*a*$。给定数组的前 $*s*$ 个元素：$*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*s*}$。其余元素通过以下公式计算：$*a*_{*i*} = (101·*a*_{*i* - *s*} + 10007) *mod* 1051131$ $(*s* < *i* ≤ 2^{*m*})$。

第一行包含三个整数 $*m*, *t*, *s*$ $(1 ≤ *m* ≤ 25; 1 ≤ *t* ≤ 10^{18}; 1 ≤ *s* ≤ *min*(2^{*m*}, 10^{5}))$。

第二行包含 $*s*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*s*} (1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6})$。

## 输出格式

为了避免输出数据过大，你只需要输出所有 $*i*$ 的答案的异或和，结果对 $1051131$ 取模 $(1 ≤ *i* ≤ 2^{*m*})$，即 $(*ans*[1] *mod* 1051131) *xor* (*ans*[2] *mod* 1051131) *xor*... *xor* (*ans*[*n*] *mod* 1051131)$。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，$*ans* = [6, 7, 6, 6]$。

如果他想在一天后位于岛屿 1，共有 6 种不同的方案：

1. 家 —> 1 -(停留)-> 1
2. 家 —> 2 —> 1
3. 家 —> 3 —> 1
4. 家 —> 3 —> 1（注意，岛屿 1 和 3 之间有两座不同的桥）
5. 家 —> 4 —> 1
6. 家 —> 4 —> 1（注意，从家到岛屿 4 有两座不同的桥）

在第二个样例中，$(*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3}, *a*_{4}, *a*_{5}, *a*_{6}, *a*_{7}, *a*_{8}) = (389094, 705719, 547193, 653800, 947499, 17024, 416654, 861849)$，$*ans* = [235771, 712729, 433182, 745954, 139255, 935785, 620229, 644335]$。
